ProductBatchItem.name: ProductBatchItem
ProductBatchItem.description: Represents the details about the product items in each batch.

AssigneeId.description: The ID of the user or group assigned to the product batch item. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

ExpirationDate.description: The date when the product batch item expires and is no longer usable.

IsActive.description: Indicates whether the batch status is active (true) or not (false).

IsProductionBatchActive.description: Indicates whether the production batch associated with the product batch item is active (true) or not (false).

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view.

LocationId.description: The location associated with the product batch item.

Name.description: The name of the product batch item.

OwnerId.description: The ID of the owner of the product batch item record.

ProductId.description: The product associated with the product batch item.

ProductItemId.description: The product item associated with the product batch item.

ProductionBatchId.description: The production batch associated with the product batch item.

QuantityUnitOfMeasure.description: The quantity of the product batch item deducted through the web interface.

RemainingQuantity.description: The remaining quantity of product items in the product batch item.
